name: copy
description: Two overlapping rounded pages with a distinct foreground sheet in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner-requested greater separation and the standard Camera/Folder main-body corner roundness. Both page centerlines use radius 3.25 with unchanged Regular 1.70 stroke and .85 round caps. Nominal rear page centerline bounds are 2.85..15.45; front page centerline bounds are 8.55..21.15 on both axes. The offset is 5.70, producing a 4.00-unit clear straight gap between the exposed parallel borders (previously 2.80). Combined visible bounds are 2..22 on both axes, with balanced 2px artboard margins. The owner requested breaks at both rear/front junctions. The rear path now starts at 5.85 15.44037035 and ends at 15.44037035 5.85, trimmed along the existing corner arcs so each radius-.85 end cap stops exactly 1 unit before the visible foreground border. These two endpoint clearances are separate from the 4-unit parallel-border gap. The front page stays unchanged. Filled uses the exact Outline exterior: outer corner radius 4.10, rear-band inner radius 2.40 and .85 end caps. Its front page is solid, with no added enclosing box or artificial hole. Position and visible exterior match between styles at native X/Y=100%, rotation=0 and Regular 1.70. Both styles were owner-approved on 2026-10-27. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Centerlines uniformly refitted about12,12 by 0.9972677596 to retain the existing2px primary margins and shared boxed glyph clearance. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Owner approved both Outline and Filled Copy with standard Camera/Folder roundness, 4px exposed page spacing, 1px breaks at both rear junctions and 2px outer margins.
